name: Model Context Protocol specification, revision 2026-07-28, TypeScript-derived JSON Schema
statement: The official machine-readable schema (JSON Schema 2020-12) of MCP 2026-07-28 at tag 2026-07-28: JSON-RPC 2.0 messages, server/discover, tools (Tool with a JSON Schema inputSchema, CallToolRequest), resources and resource templates, subscriptions, prompts, completion and errors.
